config.description: Config is passed through to the Consul agent configuration as is.

log_level.description: LogLevel of the agent: trace, debug, info, warn or error.

ip.description: IP address of the node on this network.

defaults.description: Defaults apply to every datacenter unless it overrides them.

federation.description:
Federation joins the datacenters' servers over a generated `wan`
network. Without it, datacenters are independent clusters.

addr.description: Addr of the agent's HTTP API; default <node ip>:8500.

leader.description: Leader: a raft leader is known.

members.description: Members, e.g. ">=4": alive LAN members seen by this agent.

wan_members.description:
WANMembers, e.g. ">=6": alive WAN members (servers of every
federated datacenter) seen by this server.

service_healthy.description: ServiceHealthy: this node's instance of the service is passing in the catalog.

agents.description: Agents settings apply to servers and clients alike.

server.description: Server settings apply to Consul servers only.

client.description: Client settings apply to client agents only.

service_defaults.description: ServiceDefaults are merged into every service.

primary.description: Primary marks the primary datacenter (for federation and ACLs).

subnet.description:
Subnet of the datacenter LAN, e.g. 10.1.0.0/24; picked automatically
if empty.

ui.description: UI enables the Consul web UI on the servers.

overrides.description: Per-server settings, keyed by server name (server-1, server-2, ...).

servers.description: Servers is the number of Consul servers, or {count, overrides}.

nodes.description:
Nodes besides the servers, keyed by name. A node runs a client agent
by default, plus its services and processes.

partitions.description:
Partitions are reserved for Admin Partitions (Enterprise); not
supported yet.

mode.description:
Mode is wan (serf WAN gossip between servers). mesh-gateways is
reserved.

url.description: URL to request from inside the node's namespace.

agents.description: Agents settings apply to servers and clients alike.

server.description: Server settings apply to Consul servers only.

client.description: Client settings apply to client agents only.

service_defaults.description: ServiceDefaults are merged into every service.

Inheritable.description: Inheritable holds the settings that flow down the tree.

gateway.description: Gateway is the host-side bridge address; default the subnet's .1.

count.description: Count makes N copies of the node, named <name>-1 ... <name>-N.

config.description: Config is merged into this node's agent configuration.

meta.description: Meta is the node's Consul node metadata.

service.description: Service is shorthand for one service named after the node.

services.description: Services run on this node, keyed by service name.

processes.description: Processes are extra processes on this node, keyed by name.

run.description:
Run is the command. The first word may name a versioned binary
(e.g. "consul"), which is resolved from `versions:` or Version.

version.description: Version overrides versions.<binary> for this process.

depends_on.description:
DependsOn lists processes to wait for, keyed by "<node>/<process>"
(or "<process>" on the same node).

ready_when.description: ReadyWhen says when the process counts as ready.

restart.description:
Restart is no (default), on-failure or always. It applies once the lab
is up, and only while `parker daemon` supervises the lab.

networks.description: Networks the node joins, keyed by network name.

files.description:
Files to write before start: path (relative to the node dir) to
content.

processes.description: Processes run in the node's namespace, keyed by name.

port.description: Port: ready once this TCP port accepts connections.

http.description: HTTP: ready once this URL answers with the expected status.

log.description: Log: ready once the process log contains this text.

consul.description: Consul: ready once the agent reports this state.

version.description: Version of Consul for this server, e.g. for upgrade tests.

config.description: Config is merged into this server's agent configuration.

run.description: Run is fake-service (default) or a command.

check.description: Check is the health check: http, tcp or none.

register.description: Register is merged into the Consul service registration as is.

parker.description: Parker is the schema version of this file.

name.description:
Name of the lab; defaults to the file name. Lowercase letters, digits
and '-', at most 24 characters.

versions.description:
Versions of the binaries to fetch, e.g. {consul: 1.22.7}. Add "+ent"
for Enterprise builds.

vars.description:
Vars are substituted wherever ${vars.NAME} appears; override with
--var NAME=VALUE. ${env.NAME} reads the environment.

consul.description: Consul is the high-level description: datacenters, nodes, services.

networks.description: Networks are extra low-level bridges, keyed by name.

nodes.description:
Nodes are low-level network namespaces running arbitrary processes,
keyed by name. They may join generated <dc>-lan networks.

title: Parker topology file (v1alpha1)
description: File is a whole Parker topology file.
